newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust says to boost growth of units.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust says to boost growth of units.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Frank Newman said the company is planning to improve the earnings power of some of its businesses in 1997 and to increase the growth rate of its best-performing units.

Newman, in a statement that accompanied Bankers Trust's earnings, said the businesses whose earnings power Bankers Trust seeks to improve "have not yet reaped the benefits of their strong market positions."
He did not specify the units. Officials from Bankers Trust were not immediately available to comment.
